grammar_focus: as…as / not so…as 同级比较(和…一样 / 不如…那样,KS8)+ 比较级 than / 最高级 the most + 量词 much/many 与 little/few/a little/a few(主考)+ it 形式主语(it is + adj + for sb + to do)/ 介词 + 动名词(without paying)(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 人们不再像从前那样诚实,偷窃的诱惑比以往更大——尤其在大商店里。一名侦探最近盯上一位总在星期一上午进大商店的穿着讲究的妇女。一个星期一,店里人比平常少,侦探更容易监视她。妇女先买了几样小商品,过一会儿又挑了一件最贵的连衣裙,递给一个售货员让她尽快包好;然后妇女拿起包裹没付钱就走出商店。她被捕后,侦探发现那售货员竟是她女儿——那姑娘每星期'送'母亲一件免费的连衣裙!

grammar_card.title: as…as 同级比较 与 量词
grammar_card.intro: as + 形容词/副词 + as 表示'和…一样';not so/as … as 表示'不如…那样'。再复习比较级 than、最高级 the most,以及量词 much/many 和 little/few/a little/a few。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: He is as old as I am.
不如…那样 → not so/as … as
People are not so honest as they once were.
He wrapped it up as quickly as possible.
one of the most expensive dresses

specialRules.rule: it 作形式主语,真正主语是后面的不定式:It was easier for the detective to watch her.
介词后面动词用 -ing 形式:walked out without paying;量词 little/few 表'几乎没有',a little/a few 表'一些'

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who was the thief?
options: The well-dressed woman (helped by her daughter)

passage: People are not so honest as they once were. The temptation to steal is greater than ever before — especially in large stores. A detective recently watched a well-dressed woman who always went into a large store on Monday mornings. One Monday, there were fewer people in the store than usual when the woman came in, so it was easier for the detective to watch her. The woman first bought a few small articles. After a little time, she chose one of the most expensive dresses in the store and handed it to an assistant who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible. Then the woman simply took the package and walked out of the store without paying. When she was arrested, the detective found out that the assistant was her daughter. The girl 'gave' her mother a free dress once a week!

grammar_points.name: as + 形容词/副词 + as:和…一样
as … as possible / as … as one can:尽可能…
比较级 + than(greater than / fewer … than)
量词 much/many 与 little/few/a little/a few
it 形式主语(it is + adj + for sb + to do,辅考)
介词 + 动名词(without paying,辅考)

stage5.stem: "He is ___ old as I am."(表示'和…一样')
"She ran ___ fast as her brother."(表示'和…一样快')
stage5.stem_cn: 她跑得和她哥哥一样快。

stage5.stem: "He unlocked the door as quickly ___ he could."(同级比较的第二个词)
"People are not ___ honest as they once were."(表示'不如…那样')
stage5.stem_cn: 人们不像从前那样诚实了。

stage5.stem: "She is not ___ intelligent as we think."(表示'不如…那样')
stage5.stem_cn: 她不像我们想的那么聪明。

stage5.stem: "This book is not ___ interesting as that one."(表示'不如…那样')
"He wrapped it up ___ quickly as possible."(表示'尽可能…')
"Please come ___ soon as you can."(表示'尽…')
"The temptation to steal is ___ than ever before."(比…更强,用比较级)
stage5.stem_cn: 偷窃的诱惑比以往任何时候都更强烈。

stage5.stem: "There were ___ people than usual that Monday."(比…少,修饰可数名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 那个星期一人比平常少。

stage5.stem: "She chose one of the ___ expensive dresses."(表示'最…')
stage5.stem_cn: 她挑了一件最贵的连衣裙。

stage5.stem: "It was the ___ store in town."(表示'最大的')
"The woman first bought ___ small articles."(可数名词,表示'几样')
stage5.stem_cn: 那妇女先买了几样小商品。

stage5.stem: "There is ___ milk in the bottle, so we can't make tea."(不可数,表示'几乎没有')
stage5.stem_cn: 瓶里几乎没有牛奶,泡不了茶。

stage5.stem: "It was easier ___ the detective to watch her."(it 是形式主语,真正主语在后面)
"It is important ___ us to be honest."(it 是形式主语,真正主语在后面)
"The woman walked out without ___."(介词后面动词用 -ing 形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 那妇女没付钱就走了出去。

stage5.stem: "She left after ___ the dress."(介词后面动词用 -ing 形式)
stage5.stem_cn: 她拿了连衣裙后就离开了。
